limits: Draws the record's features and the chosen enzymes' sites; it infers nothing.
bio.jane/contract.noReading: A rendering: the map drawn as SVG, with nothing inferred.
bio.jane/contract.question: What does this molecule's map look like as a publication figure, circular or linear?

description: Render the open record's map to a publication SVG string, circular or linear — the same figure the Export panel draws, with the same knobs and the same defaults. Give it enzymes to draw the restriction sites. The linear layout can draw both strands' bases and a window of the record (start/end), which is the sequence view as a figure.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

collapse_duplicate_labels.description: fold leader labels that would repeat a name into one row, as `misc_binding ×13` — the same rule the interactive map uses. Off reproduces the upstream renderer's figure exactly, one leader per feature.

end.description: linear only: last base of the window to draw (1-based, inclusive); left unset, the record's last base. In bp. Only applies when layout is linear.

enzymes.description: enzymes whose cut sites fill the site ring — resolved against the bundled cut catalog (REBASE spellings; smaller than the REBASE dossier the editor shows). Left unset, the run uses your active enzyme collection; with none active the ring is drawn empty rather than silently filled.

font.description: figure font — one of the three stacks that survive an SVG-to-PDF conversion without substitution.

layout.description: circular: the ring; linear: the record unrolled into rows, features in lanes under a ruler and sites above it.

legend.description: add a colour key on its own strip below the map.

show_bases.description: linear only: draw both strands' bases over the ruler; rows wrap to keep each base readable. Only applies when layout is linear.

show_labels.description: draw each feature's name beside its arc.

size.description: square canvas edge, before a legend strip is added below it. In px.

start.description: linear only: first base of the window to draw (1-based); left unset, the record's first base. In bp. Only applies when layout is linear.

title.description: figure title; left empty, the record's own name is used.

transparent.description: omit the backing rect, so the figure drops onto any ground.

name: export_map_svg

height.description: rendered height in px — taller than the width when a legend strip was added

rows.description: rows a linear map wrapped into; 0 for the circular layout

sites.description: cut sites drawn (the outer ring, or the ticks above a linear map's ruler)
